messages.subject: Brookmere / Caspian MSA - our mark-up
messages.plaintextBody:
James,

Our mark-up of the MSA attached (tracked). The main moves you'll see: liability cap up to 300% of annual fees, payment terms out to 45 days, renewal notice down to 60 days, and a new dataset accuracy warranty in clause 9. Brookmere need comfort on dataset accuracy given they rely on the Output for regulatory disclosure.

Happy to talk these through.

Regards,
Adam Selby
Partner, Denham Lewis LLP

messages.subject: RE: Brookmere / Caspian MSA - our mark-up
messages.plaintextBody:
Adam,

Thanks. 300% is a long way from where Caspian can land - their standard is 100% and the dataset is expressly modelled/estimated data, so a broad accuracy warranty is a non-starter. I expect we can give you a narrow error-correction obligation instead. Let me take instructions and revert with a counter. Can we hold a call in the new year, w/c 5 January?

James

--
James Osei
Senior Associate, Commercial
Whitfield Carter LLP | 22 Bishopsgate, London EC2N 4BQ
Confidential and may be legally privileged.
